subject.title: Bug: Isolated cron job delivery.mode=announce fails with 'Channel openclaw-weixin does not support action send'

question: Is the stable WeChat repro plus source-level `message.action` failure enough to authorize a focused fix, or should maintainers require a current-main live trace that identifies the exact cron path first?
rationale: Current main shows both a compatible durable-outbound fallback and the still-failing gateway action guard, so maintainer intent is needed before automation changes one side of the boundary.

options.title: Require current-main trace first
options.body: Ask for redacted current-main or latest-release logs that show whether the agent message tool, gateway RPC, or runner fallback reaches `message.action=send` before queueing a fix.

options.title: Authorize a focused core fix now
options.body: Allow a bounded repair that routes send actions for direct-only plugins through core outbound delivery, with regression coverage and WeChat proof before merge.

options.title: Defer to plugin owner
options.body: Keep the OpenClaw issue open but require `openclaw-weixin` maintainers to add an action handler, accepting duplicate send contracts in the plugin.

recommendation.title: Require current-main trace first
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted current-main or latest-release logs that show whether the agent message tool, gateway RPC, or runner fallback reaches `message.action=send` before queueing a fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The ambiguous boundary is between message-action routing and core outbound delivery, where this person has recent relevant history.
